sources.title: AI Model Detector — Which AI Made This Image? | PromptShotAI
sources.snippet: How AI model detection works Every AI image generator leaves fingerprints — the way it renders hands, eyes, textures, and edges, the kinds of artifacts it produces, the look of its lighting. The AI model detector reads those tells and tells you which model most likely made the image, with a confidence score and an explanation of the evidence, plus a prompt tuned for that model so you can ...

sources.title: JustModels.ai | Create & Train Custom AI Models (No Code)
sources.snippet: How does JustModels.ai compare to other AI platforms? JustModels.ai is the only no-code platform that combines custom LoRA model training, text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and ReelsRecreator in one place. Competitors like Civitai require technical knowledge, and platforms like Leonardo.ai lack custom training and video recreation features.
